clue.text: Not worried about heartless whistleblower

indicators.note: a thing without its heart has lost its central letter

blocks.note: ca. (circa) means about
the official who blows the whistle in a match

explanation.surface: Someone shrugs off a whistleblower who has no heart, as if the informer posed no threat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Whistleblower' suggests a leaker of secrets, but here it is the match official; REFEREE loses its middle E.
explanation.definitionFit: Carefree describes a person untroubled by anxieties, a direct synonym of being not worried.

clue.text: A line in article jerks put together for sport

indicators.note: in places one piece inside another, here inside the article
put together means the pieces are joined one after another

blocks.note: taken as written
the definite article
L is the abbreviation for line
tics are involuntary twitches

explanation.surface: A sporting body appears to be assembled from a line of awkward fools.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jerks' reads as an insult for fools, but it means twitches.
explanation.definitionFit: Athletics is the sport of track and field events such as running and jumping.

clue.text: Retrieval of property — that could be the case

indicators.note: the words could be something else entirely, so their letters may be rearranged into another word

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A lawyer remarks that reclaiming property might well be the issue in this lawsuit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The case' looks like legal talk to match the definition, but it is merely the letters to be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Escheat is the legal reversion of property to the state or lord when there is no heir, a reclaiming of it.

clue.text: Mostly communicate with one — none is any longer in specific circle

definitions.text: none is any longer in specific circle

indicators.note: mostly means most but not all of the word, so its final letter is dropped

blocks.note: to radio is to communicate by wireless
Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone mostly gets in touch with one person, and none of a certain group is longer.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is cryptic: within any given circle all the lines from centre to edge are equal, so none is longer than another.
explanation.definitionFit: The radii of a circle all share the same length, so no one of them exceeds any other.

clue.text: For cameraman, between one minute and the next is a long time

indicators.text: between one minute and the next
indicators.note: the word sits inside the given word between two occurrences of the letter that abbreviates minute

blocks.note: the letters lying between the two Ms of this word

explanation.surface: A cameraman finds the wait between one minute and the next seems to last ages.
explanation.walkthrough: M is the abbreviation for minute, and cameraman contains two of them.
explanation.definitionFit: An era is an extended historical period, so it serves as a long time.

clue.text: A girl finally dated man in recess

indicators.note: finally points to the very end of the word, keeping only its last letter

blocks.note: taken as written
the end of girl
cove is old-fashioned British slang for a man or chap

explanation.surface: A girl at last went out with a man in a quiet nook.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dated' seems to be a verb about going out with someone, but it marks COVE as an old-fashioned word for a man.
explanation.definitionFit: An alcove is a recess set back into the wall of a room.

clue.text: Unspecified relative putting in effort as paper's adviser

indicators.note: putting something in means placing it inside the other phrase

blocks.note: any aunt, an aunt not specified
a go is an attempt or effort

explanation.surface: Some relative makes an effort and becomes the newspaper's advice columnist.
explanation.walkthrough: GO goes inside ANY AUNT after the A. An agony aunt is the British term for an advice columnist.
explanation.definitionFit: An agony aunt writes a newspaper column answering readers' personal problems, so she is the paper's adviser.

clue.text: Framework produced by church covering aid, mostly

indicators.note: mostly means all but a bit, so the last letter is lost
in a down answer, one piece covering another sits on top of it

blocks.note: CH is the abbreviation for church
assist means help or aid

explanation.surface: A church's scaffolding appears to be largely funded by outside aid.
explanation.definitionFit: A chassis is the base frame of a vehicle on which the body is built.

clue.text: Revolutionary kind of dwelling

blocks.note: first meaning: Pancho ..., the Mexican revolutionary leader
second meaning: a large country or holiday house

explanation.surface: Someone describes a radically new kind of home design.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolutionary' reads as an adjective meaning innovative, but it is a noun naming the Mexican rebel general.
explanation.definitionFit: Pancho Villa led forces in the Mexican Revolution, and a villa is also a type of house.

clue.text: Ken's withdrawn from participant in primacy dispute — that's smart

indicators.note: a name withdrawn from a word is taken out of it

blocks.note: the man's name, as written
the chicken in the chicken-and-egg question of which came first

explanation.surface: A man named Ken has pulled out of a contest over who comes first, which is a clever move.
explanation.walkthrough: The primacy dispute is the old riddle of which came first, the chicken or the egg.
explanation.definitionFit: Chic means stylish and fashionable, the sense of smart as in well dressed.

clue.text: Bishop is so moved, along with lady I converted

indicators.note: converted means changed into a different form, so the letters are reworked

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A bishop is touched, along with a lady he has brought to the faith.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bishop' and 'converted' set up a churchy scene, but the bishop is the chess piece.
explanation.definitionFit: In chess a bishop moves only along diagonal lines across the board.

clue.text: Wrong kind of surgeon for person — confused vein with artery

definitions.text: Wrong kind of surgeon for person

indicators.note: confused means mixed up, so these letters are jumbled

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A patient complains that a surgeon muddled up a vein and an artery, so was the wrong sort of doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: The surgeon who is wrong for a human patient is one who treats animals.
explanation.definitionFit: A veterinary surgeon treats animals, so would be the wrong choice to operate on a human.

clue.text: Versus Arsenal, initially gets extra time

indicators.note: initially points to the start of the word, keeping just its first letter

blocks.note: the first letter of Arsenal
gains means acquires more
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A match report: against Arsenal, a team gets taken into extra time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extra time' looks like a football phrase, but 'gets extra' and 'time' are separate pieces. Arsenal is a London football club.
explanation.definitionFit: Against and versus both mean in opposition to, as in a match between two sides.

clue.text: Playwright making wise statement about what his heroine would keep missing

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece wraps the other

blocks.note: a saw is an old saying or proverb

blocks.clueFragment: what his heroine would keep missing
blocks.note: Eliza Doolittle of Pygmalion drops her aitches in Cockney speech

explanation.surface: A dramatist makes a wise remark about something his leading lady always forgets.
explanation.walkthrough: The heroine is Eliza Doolittle in Pygmalion, whose Cockney speech drops the H sound until she is taught otherwise.
explanation.definitionFit: George Bernard Shaw was the Irish playwright who wrote Pygmalion.

clue.text: State carriage

blocks.note: first meaning: an Australian state whose capital is Melbourne
second meaning: a light four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage

explanation.walkthrough: 'State carriage' reads as a royal coach for ceremonies; split, the two words each name the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Victoria is both a state of Australia and a kind of low open horse-drawn carriage.

clue.text: Pinafore was in this combination of blues

indicators.note: a combination joins things together, so the two pieces are set side by side

blocks.note: royal blue is a deep bright blue
navy blue is a dark blue

explanation.surface: Someone recalls an apron belonging to an outfit made of mixed blue shades.
explanation.walkthrough: HMS Pinafore is the Gilbert and Sullivan comic opera set aboard a British warship; 'blues' supplies two shades.
explanation.definitionFit: HMS Pinafore is a fictional ship of Britain's naval service in the operetta.

clue.text: As result, down is freezing? Just the opposite

indicators.note: each preceding word is swapped for its opposite before use

blocks.note: the opposite of down
is shortened as in a contraction
the opposite of freezing

explanation.surface: Someone notes that a feeling of being low is really cold, then corrects to the reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: Turn 'down is freezing' into its opposite, 'up's hot', and run it together.
explanation.definitionFit: An upshot is the final outcome or consequence of something.

clue.text: Controlling awful bosses I have

indicators.note: awful suggests something in a terrible state, so the letters are in disorder

blocks.note: taken as written
I have contracts to I've

explanation.surface: An employee complains about the domineering, dreadful managers they work for.
explanation.definitionFit: Obsessive behaviour is compulsive and controlling, as in a fixated need to dominate.

clue.text: Raptor circles victim

blocks.note: O is a circle, so more than one are Os
prey is the victim of a hunter

explanation.surface: A bird of prey wheels in the sky above its target.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Circles' looks like a verb of a bird wheeling overhead, but it is a plural noun for the round letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The osprey is a fish-eating bird of prey, and raptor is the term for such birds.

clue.text: Catalogue once more includes a non-abstract artist

indicators.note: one thing including another holds it within

blocks.note: to relist is to catalogue again
taken as written

explanation.surface: An updated catalogue adds a painter who works figuratively.
explanation.definitionFit: A realist painter depicts subjects as they really appear, the opposite of abstract art.

clue.text: Name a holidaymaker lacking nothing who barely enjoys the open air?

definitions.text: who barely enjoys the open air?

indicators.note: lacking means without, so a letter is removed

blocks.note: N is the abbreviation for name
taken as written
a tourist is someone on holiday
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Someone names a tourist who has nothing on and loves the fresh air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Barely' is a pun: the person in the open air wears nothing at all. 'Lacking nothing' removes the O from the holidaymaker.
explanation.definitionFit: A naturist is a nudist, someone who enjoys being outdoors without clothes.

clue.text: Have second thoughts about weak king

blocks.note: re means concerning, about
thin as in a weak, feeble excuse
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Courtiers reconsider their position concerning a feeble monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About' looks like the link to what is reconsidered, but it gives the opening piece.
explanation.definitionFit: To rethink is to consider something again and change one's mind about it.

clue.text: Some seabirds returning, or just one

indicators.note: returning means going back the way they came, so read the word from its end

blocks.note: auks are diving seabirds such as puffins and guillemots

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher sees a few seabirds coming back, or possibly only a single one.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition leans on the wordplay: 'just one' means one seabird, a different species from the plural group.
explanation.definitionFit: A skua is a large predatory seabird, so it is one such bird.

clue.text: Stop following bear? Not really

indicators.note: following here is a phrase meaning in the manner of, a piece of the answer placed after the first

blocks.note: a knockout stops a boxing fight
a la means in the style of, following

explanation.surface: A command to stop chasing a bear, then a doubt whether it truly is one.
explanation.walkthrough: A koala is a marsupial, not a true bear, despite the name 'koala bear'.
explanation.definitionFit: The koala is often called a bear but is actually a marsupial, so a bear only in name.

clue.text: In general, it must establish definitive check

clue.text: Unqualified, so to speak

clue.text: Financier making statement that's true about Turkey or Thailand

clue.text: Partly switching sides is of little consequence

the letter to be removed
